description.text:
Gem Pack (宝可梦卡牌 宝石包) Volume 6 came out on 7 August 2026, introduced with Applin, whose evolution depends on the taste of its apple. As in the earlier volumes, every card is a holo, four to a pack, and each Pokémon comes in several finishes of the same art, among them a pattern of its Energy type, a Master Ball pattern and the Gem Pack logo. Every Pokémon in the volume also has an art illustration card; Applin's new one shows a bright, cosy kitchen full of fruity treats, where Applin, tucked into its apple, blends right in.

This volume holds only Pokémon: 28 of them, among them Applin, Flapple, Appletun and Dipplin, Poltchageist, and Okidogi, Munkidori and Fezandipiti, each in seven versions. The cards are numbered with four digits, the first two for the Pokémon, from 01 for Alolan Dugtrio to 28 for Fezandipiti, and the last two for the version, out of 07.
